name: us023-plan-md-invalidates
description: 023, Phase 5, US3 (research R4, contract run-state-v2.md §1 C3): two runs, same event (after_specify), spec.md byte-identical between them. Run 1 has no plan.md at all. Before run 2, plan.md is written with a `## Summary` section -- a file spec.md's own hash never covers, so the pre-023 run-state document would have short-circuited run 2 with zero requests despite the new content. Run 2 must be a full reconcile, and the parent's PUT must carry the new "Implementation Plan" section in its description -- the live content defect research R4 documents on unpatched code, closed here.
